name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Jerk
steps: Hold a single kettlebell in the front rack position on one side with your feet hip-width apart, elbow tucked against your torso, and wrist straight.
Dip quickly at the knees while keeping your chest upright, then extend your hips and knees explosively to drive the kettlebell upward off your chest.
Drop swiftly underneath the kettlebell into a brief second knee bend while locking your arm straight overhead, then stand tall.
Absorb the descent by softening your knees as you lower the bell back to the rack, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep both feet planted during the dip and drive upward with your torso upright.
Keep your working biceps close to your ear at lockout and stabilize before lowering.
